opening.argument: The segment identifies itself as a fact check of a purported $250 Walmart gift-card offer, not an invitation to claim it. It reports that Walmart has no promotions or incentive programs leading to such a gift card, and warns that the offer’s verification link appears designed to obtain people’s information. Its conclusion is explicit: the promotion is false and fake. The closing request is for viewers to send items to the Verify team for investigation, not to pay, provide credentials, or participate in the offer. The gift-card claim is the subject of scrutiny, not a solicitation the presenter endorses.

citations.quote: It is Verify time and today our fact checkers are taking a closer look at this very tempting offer.
There are no promotions or incentive programs that lead to a Walmart gift card.
this one looks like one of those phishing scams where hackers are trying to get your info when you click on that verification link
So, after all this, we can verify the Walmart gift card promotion really is too good be true. It is false and a fake.
